description: Memory API for AI agents: long-term memory, user profiles, search and connectors. The current API is v5.
rules: The current API is v5. Every call is scoped to a namespace: POST /ns/{namespace}/document, /ns/{namespace}/search, /ns/{namespace}/profile.
Use the supermemory SDK version 5 or later: client.add(namespace, { content }), client.search(namespace, { query }), client.profile(namespace).
Do not use containerTag, containerTags, /v3 or /v4 in new code; those API versions shut down on December 31, 2026.
